minDelaySeconds.title: Minimum delay (seconds)
minDelaySeconds.description: Shortest wait before the screen turns green.

maxDelaySeconds.title: Maximum delay (seconds)
maxDelaySeconds.description: Longest wait before the screen turns green.

windowSeconds.title: Tap window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: How long after GO players may still tap.

maxPoints.title: Points for the fastest tap
maxPoints.description: Taps lose one point per equal step of time between the two reaction times below.

fullPointsMs.title: Full points up to (ms)
fullPointsMs.description: Reaction times up to this earn the maximum. Measured on the server, so it includes the Wi-Fi delay.

zeroPointsMs.title: No points from (ms)
zeroPointsMs.description: Reaction times from this on earn 0 points.

falseStartPenalty.title: False start penalty
falseStartPenalty.description: Points subtracted for tapping before GO. Recorded as a negative score for this challenge; 0 disables the penalty.
